lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, vibrate and meditate on the Lord; let your awareness be absorbed in Him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਾਇਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man har bhaj naam naraain ||
lines.translation: O my mind, vibrate and meditate on the Lord and the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾਇਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har kripaa kare sukhadaataa guramukh bhavajal har naam taraain ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, the Giver of Peace, grants His Grace; the Gurmukh crosses over the terrifying world-ocean through the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, sing of the Lord.
Follow the Guru's Teachings, and you shall obtain the Lord, the Source of Nectar. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਧੂ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗਿਆਨ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਇਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur saadhoo a(n)mrit giaan sar naain ||
lines.translation: Bathe in the pool of ambrosial nectar, the spiritual wisdom of the Holy Guru.
All sins will be eliminated and eradicated. ||3||
You Yourself are the Creator, the Support of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਇਣੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak mel teraa daas dasaain ||4||1||
lines.translation: Please unite servant Nanak with Yourself; he is the slave of Your slaves. ||4||1||
Bhairao, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਫਲ ਸਾ ਘਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bol har naam saphal saa gharee ||
lines.translation: Fruitful is that moment when the Lord's Name is spoken.
Following the Guru's Teachings, all pains are taken away. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man har bhaj naam naraharee ||
lines.translation: O my mind, vibrate the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਭਉ ਤਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa melahu gur pooraa satasa(n)gat sa(n)g si(n)dh bhau taree ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Lord, be merciful, and unite me with the Perfect Guru. Joining with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I shall cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
Meditate on the Life of the World; remember the Lord in your mind.
Millions upon millions of your sins shall be taken away. ||2||
In the Sat Sangat, apply the dust of the feet of the holy to your face;
this is how to bathe in the sixty-eight sacred shrines, and the Ganges. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham moorakh kau har kirapaa karee ||
lines.translation: I am a fool; the Lord has shown mercy to me.
The Savior Lord has saved servant Nanak. ||4||2||
Bhairao, Fourth Mehl:
To do good deeds is the best rosary.
Chant on the beads within your heart, and it shall go along with you. ||1||
Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Lord of the forest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੂਟਿ ਗਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa melahu satasa(n)gat toot gaee maaiaa jam jaalee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Have mercy on me, Lord, and unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, so that I may be released from Maya's noose of death. ||1||Pause||
Whoever, as Gurmukh, serves and works hard,
is molded and shaped in the true mint of the Shabad, the Word of God. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਦਿਖਾਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har agam agochar gur agam dikhaalee ||
lines.translation: The Guru has revealed to me the Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਲਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਲੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: vich kaaiaa nagar ladhaa har bhaalee ||3||
lines.translation: Searching within the body-village, I have found the Lord. ||3||
I am just a child; the Lord is my Father, who nurtures and cherishes me.
Please save servant Nanak, Lord; bless him with Your Glance of Grace. ||4||3||
Bhairao, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ghat tere too sabhanaa maahi ||
lines.translation: All hearts are Yours, Lord; You are in all.
There is nothing at all except You. ||1||
O my mind, meditate on the Lord, the Giver of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਾਪੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau tudh saalaahee too meraa har prabh baap ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I praise You, O Lord God, You are my Father. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah jah dekhaa tah har prabh soi ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, I see only the Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabh terai vas doojaa avar na koi ||2||
lines.translation: All are under Your control; there is no other at all. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kau tum har raakhiaa bhaavai ||
lines.translation: O Lord, when it is Your Will to save someone,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਨੇੜੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tis kai neRai koi na jaavai ||3||
lines.translation: then nothing can threaten him. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸਭ ਤੈ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: too jal thal maheeal sabh tai bharapoor ||
lines.translation: You are totally pervading and permeating the waters, the lands, the skies and all places.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਾਜਰਾ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har jap haajaraa hajoor ||4||4||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Ever-present Lord. ||4||4||
Bhairao, Fourth Mehl, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa sa(n)t har kee har moorat jis hiradai har naam muraar ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Saint is the embodiment of the Lord; within his heart is the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: masatak bhaag hovai jis likhiaa so guramat hiradai har naam samhaar ||1||
lines.translation: One who has such destiny inscribed on his forehead, follows the Guru's Teachings, and contemplates the Name of the Lord within his heart. ||1||
